name: Stress response regulation with mitochondrial depolarization and apoptosis
rationale: Members modulate cellular responses to drugs, antibiotics, oxidative, hypoxic and osmotic stress together with apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization, whereas confusables centre on respiration/ATP synthesis or ethanol/anesthetic responses.

name: Chaperonin and chaperone-mediated protein folding and refolding
rationale: All members concern chaperone-assisted folding (CCT/TRiC of actin and tubulin, prefoldin, ER folding, refolding, inclusion-body suppression), distinct from confusables built on tubulin modification, telomerase/Cajal body or RHOBTB2 cycles.

qualifier: axonal nodal domains and dendrite self-avoidance
name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion at axon nodes and dendrites
rationale: Members are L1-family, nectin, DSCAM and SDK adhesion interactions organising nodal/paranodal axon domains, sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance, unlike confusables on L1 recycling/repulsion, myelination, RPTP signaling or NCAM1.

qualifier: SOS and MRAS-SHOC2 driven RAF activation
name: RAS-RAF-MAPK activation via SOS and MRAS-SHOC2
rationale: Members describe activating RAS signaling to RAF, MEK, RSK and p38 (SOS, MRAS-SHOC2, MAP2K mutants), whereas confusables emphasise GAP-mediated RAS inactivation and ERK negative feedback.

name: Rho activation by G alpha 12/13 receptors and Sema4D
rationale: Members converge on RhoA activation through G12/13-coupled GPCRs and Sema4D/plexin-B (with RND1), while confusables are Sema3A/plexin-A axon repulsion or other Rho-family cycles.

qualifier: Treg induction and Th1/Th17, IL-2, IFN-gamma inhibition
name: Effector T cell suppression and regulatory T cell induction
rationale: Members negatively regulate CD4/CD8 T cell activation, proliferation, Th1/Th17 commitment and IL-2/IFN-gamma production while promoting Treg differentiation, unlike confusables on Th1 differentiation, DC costimulation or tolerance induction.

name: Skeletal myogenesis and postsynaptic neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members cover muscle fiber differentiation plus postsynaptic NMJ assembly (acetylcholine receptor clustering, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, agrin-bearing proteoglycans), distinct from confusables on cholinergic transmission, basement membrane or diaphragm development.

core: DNA repair of base and nucleotide lesions
qualifier: excision, mismatch, translesion and direct reversal rather than double-strand breaks
name: Excision, mismatch and translesion DNA repair
rationale: Members span base excision, nucleotide excision, mismatch repair, translesion synthesis and alkylation reversal (with related replication and demethylation steps), whereas confusables are double-strand break, homologous recombination and NHEJ repair.

qualifier: pyrimidine and nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis including thiopurines
name: Pyrimidine and nucleoside triphosphate catabolism
rationale: Members degrade pyrimidine nucleotides and hydrolyse (deoxy)nucleoside triphosphates including NUDT-mediated pool sanitisation and thiopurine metabolism, unlike confusables on nucleotide biosynthesis, salvage and purine deoxynucleoside metabolism.

name: Vocal learning, auditory and mechanosensory behavior
rationale: Members concern vocalization, vocal and observational learning, auditory and mechanosensory responses (with striatum development), distinct from confusables on social/mating, locomotor or cerebellar development behavior.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 in dendritic cells and monocytes
name: Myeloid MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation, NKT cell regulation and dendritic cell/monocyte surface signatures, whereas confusables focus on MHC class I cross-presentation or lymphocyte surface signatures.

name: Iron and heme transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern cellular iron and heme import, transferrin cycling, ferroportin/ceruloplasmin defects and iron sequestration at host-pathogen interfaces, unlike confusables on oxygen transport, copper/manganese/cadmium handling or scavenger receptors.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and import
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial tRNA 5'-leader removal, 3'-end processing, modification and RNA import, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, ribosome assembly or nuclear tRNA processing.

qualifier: sensorimotor gating and glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission enhancement
name: Locomotor behavior, sensorimotor gating and synaptic transmission enhancement
rationale: Members combine exploratory, locomotor, grooming and prepulse-inhibition behaviors with positive regulation of glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, which confusables on vocal, sensory or cerebellar behavior lack.

name: USP and UCH deubiquitinase control of protein degradation
rationale: Members concern USP/UCH deubiquitination and negative regulation of proteasomal degradation and protein stability, unlike confusables on E3 ligases, other DUB families, proteasome assembly, ERAD or autophagy.

qualifier: membrane insertion and COPII anterograde transport
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER membrane plus COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport, distinct from confusables on COPI retrograde traffic, ER quality control and ERAD.

name: Epithelial adherens junction and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated adherens junction assembly/maintenance with apical-basal polarity and apical constriction, whereas confusables emphasise desmosomes, cadherin degradation, EMT or endothelial junctions.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and GPI anchor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, distinct from confusables on dolichol/N-glycan, GDP-mannose and sialic acid metabolism.

qualifier: reverse cholesterol transport and foam cell suppression
name: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport regulation
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly, reverse cholesterol transport, LXR targets and suppression of foam cell formation, unlike confusables on lipoprotein remodeling, SREBP-driven synthesis or cholesterol import.

qualifier: contractile phenotype maintenance and vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle differentiation and vessel remodeling
rationale: Members promote VSMC development and differentiation, restrain dedifferentiation and chemotaxis, and regulate vessel remodeling, whereas confusables address VSMC proliferation/migration switching or endothelial activation.

name: Presynaptic dopamine synthesis and transporter-mediated reuptake
rationale: Members concern dopamine biosynthesis, catecholamine metabolism and dopamine transporter uptake (including its disease defects), distinct from confusables on dopamine receptor signaling, release, or norepinephrine/serotonin transport.

name: Host transcriptional control of viruses and endogenous retroelements
rationale: Members concern host activation and silencing of viral and retroelement transcription (HCMV, KRAB-ZFP, HUSH, latency), whereas confusables are HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration steps.

qualifier: stability, localization and ceRNA translation control
name: Post-transcriptional and post-translational regulation of PTEN
rationale: Members regulate PTEN level and activity via ceRNAs/lncRNAs, stability, localization and cancer loss of function, distinct from confusables on downstream AKT/TORC2 signaling.

name: TLR7/8/9-driven type I interferon production via IRF5/7
rationale: Members concern TLR7/8/9 signaling through TRAF6-IRF7 and TASL-IRF5 to IFN-alpha/beta in activated dendritic cells, unlike confusables on TLR3, endosomal TLR trafficking or cGAS-STING.

name: APC/C ubiquitin ligase control of anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C regulation and K11/branched ubiquitination degrading securin, cyclins and other substrates at the metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit, whereas confusables cover cohesion, spindle, meiosis or G1/S-G2 checkpoints.
